title: Calisthenics with Cats
subtitle: Just a mat and a cat

safety.intro: Move in a comfortable range. Use an easier version whenever you need it. Stop if pain, chest pain, severe dizziness or feeling faint develops.
safety.support: If balance is uncertain, work near a wall or sturdy chair and keep support within easy reach.

exercises.title: Cat Stretch / Cat-Cow
exercises.intro: Come onto hands and knees. Move gently between a soft arch and a comfortable rounded back.
exercises.cue: Move slowly. Let the movement follow your breathing.
exercises.mod: Keep the movement small if your back feels sensitive.
exercises.next: Next is a short plank. Knees down is absolutely fine.

exercises.title: Forearm Plank
exercises.intro: Set your elbows under your shoulders. Choose toes, knees, or a raised surface.
exercises.cue: Stay long through the body. Breathe steadily.
exercises.mod: Shorten the hold or use knees down if your back, neck or shoulders complain.
exercises.next: Next is the push-up. Knees down or a higher surface is fine.

exercises.title: Push-Up
exercises.intro: Hands under shoulders. Choose a full push-up, knees down, or a higher surface.
exercises.cue: Lower with control. Clean repetitions, not rushed ones.
exercises.mod: Use a wall or secure countertop if floor push-ups are uncomfortable.
exercises.next: Next we turn onto the side for leg circles.

exercises.title: Side-Lying Leg Circles
exercises.intro: Lie comfortably on your side. We will do thirty seconds on each side.
exercises.cue: Small smooth circles. Keep the hips as steady as you comfortably can.
exercises.mod: Bend the moving knee slightly and make a smaller circle if needed.

exercises.title: Glute Bridge
exercises.intro: Lie on your back with knees bent and feet comfortable. Lift only as high as feels good.
exercises.cue: Lift gently, pause, and lower with control.
exercises.mod: Use a mini bridge if your back feels sensitive.

advanced.title: Headstand — advanced optional
advanced.note: Not part of normal autoplay. Do not use this app to learn a headstand. Only for people already comfortable with inversions and a safe setup.
